name: The Santa Maria Hotel & Golf Resort
insider_take: Where championship golf meets Panama's Pacific coastline in luxurious harmony
whats_special: This oceanfront resort sits on 340 acres along Panama's stunning Playa Blanca, featuring Jack Nicklaus-designed championship golf course that's considered one of Central America's finest. The property seamlessly blends Spanish colonial architecture with modern luxury, offering direct beach access and panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean.
pro_tip: Book tee times during the dry season (December-April) for optimal playing conditions, and don't miss the sunset views from the 18th hole overlooking the ocean.
dont_miss: The resort's world-class spa treatments incorporating indigenous ingredients, fresh ceviche at the beachfront restaurant, and exploring nearby Coiba National Park - a UNESCO World Heritage site known as the "Galapagos of Panama" with incredible diving and marine biodiversity just a boat ride away.
pros: Championship 18-hole golf course with stunning ocean views
Beachfront location with private beach access
Multiple dining venues offering international and local cuisine
cons: Remote location requiring transportation to Panama City center
Premium pricing typical of luxury resort properties
